summary: Submitting the robustness variant of the primary scenario under the recommended production configuration, so the held proposal cannot be attributed to default flags or to a clock that never advances. It is a successor of the ticks experiment in the primary investigation: PreVote and CheckQuorum are both enabled, the logical clock is advanced ten rounds with delivery between rounds before the invocation, and the witness and control events carry their own names. Four comparisons cover the re-added voter's invocation staying pending, its payload not being committed, and the never-removed member's invocation returning and committing under the same flags. A local dry run through the framework's own comparator shows all four as complete holds: the witness invocation returned false at 901 ms with leader 1 still in StateLeader and the member a voter, its payload absent, while the control returned true and committed on all three nodes. The submission is validated with execution requested, and its receipt will be interpreted next, replacing the last implicit gap in the parent account about configuration flags.
